description: This file defines the Compact formatter class for the SCSSPHP library, which formats SCSS output in a compact style. It extends the Formatter class and sets specific formatting properties, but is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: Compact
classes.description: A formatter class for SCSSPHP that outputs compactly formatted SCSS, though it is deprecated in favor of the 'Compressed' formatter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the formatter with specific formatting options and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: indentStr
methods.description: Returns the indentation string used by this formatter, which is a single space.
